name: Product Design
headline: From a raw idea to a product worth building.
intro: Hands-on product consultation for founders and teams: validate the problem, shape the solution, define the first release and plan the path to market.

overview.what: Product design and consultation sits before and around engineering. It covers idea validation, market and user research, feature prioritisation, MVP definition, technical feasibility, roadmaps and early prototypes.
overview.why: Most products fail not because they were built badly, but because they solved the wrong problem or tried to do too much at once. Clear thinking early is far cheaper than rebuilding later.
problems: An idea with no clear definition of who it is for or why they would pay
A feature list so long the first release never ships
Uncertainty over which technology, platform or budget is appropriate
Teams building in different directions without a shared roadmap
overview.approach: We work alongside you in short, structured workshops: sharpen the problem, test assumptions cheaply, cut scope to the smallest valuable release, and produce a plan and prototype that engineers can estimate accurately.

deliver.d: Problem and audience definition, assumptions to test and early signals of demand.
A clear view of alternatives, positioning gaps and pricing reference points.
A prioritised, right-sized first release with explicit goals and exclusions.
Documentation that development teams can estimate and build from.
A clickable concept to test with users and show to partners or investors.
Phased delivery plan with architecture recommendations, timeline and budget range.

capabilities.d: Facilitated sessions that align founders, teams and stakeholders on goals and constraints.
Scoring by value, effort and risk so the right things are built first.
Landing pages, concierge pilots and prototypes that test demand before large investment.
Pragmatic guidance on build versus buy, platforms, integrations and scalability.
Subscription, usage and licence models examined against your market.
Product narrative, demo flows and supporting visuals for fundraising conversations.

process.d: We understand your idea, background, resources and what success looks like.
Market, users and competitors are examined and the riskiest assumptions are tested.
Features, flows and positioning are worked out and then cut down to the essentials.
A concept is built and put in front of real potential users.
Requirements, architecture, roadmap and estimates are documented.
Take the plan to any team, or continue with Gentrobyte into development and launch.

benefits.d: Assumptions are tested before large sums are spent on development.
A tight first release gets to market sooner and learns from real users.
Clear requirements make cost and timeline predictions more reliable.
Founders, designers and engineers work to the same plan.
A defined concept and roadmap make your story easier to tell.

usecases.d: An idea is tested, defined and turned into an MVP plan and prototype.
A new digital product line is scoped before committing budget.
Requirements are gathered from teams to build the right system first time.
A roadmap review identifies what to improve, remove or add next.

cta.h: Bring us the idea. We will help you sharpen it.
cta.p: A first conversation costs you nothing but clarity. Tell us what you are thinking about building and for whom.
